name: search_investigations
description: List the 24 PSI combustion investigations as cards; filter by fire-safety pillar, fuel phase or flight/ground, and rank by a keyword query.

name: get_investigation
description: Full knowledge record of one investigation: question, physics (with equations), method, test matrix, measurements, PSI data, findings with quoted sources, fire-safety relevance, limitations, open questions.

name: filter_tests
description: Rows of the per-test table (2,177 tests: fuel, O2, pressure, flow, outcomes). Use for any question about what was tested and what happened.

fuel.description: a normalised fuel name, matched as a whole word: pmma, heptane (also n-heptane blends); ethane does not return methane

config.description: substring: normal, inverse, coflow, droplet, opposed flow, concurrent flow

pressure_kpa.description: [min, max]; null leaves that end open

flow_cm_s.description: [min, max]; null leaves that end open

outcome.description: solid-fuel runs of BASS (PSI-26) and BASS-II (PSI-25) only: how the flame ended, read from the crew's notes; each row quotes its source in outcome_quote and gives outcome_cause (blowoff, low_flow, nitrogen, unspecified) when extinguished. Null on most rows: not stated

exclude_flags.description: drop rows carrying any of these flag codes

name: compare
description: Side-by-side comparison of investigations: question, fuels, tested ranges, sensors, key findings, limitations.

name: coverage
description: Count tests on a 2-D grid (default ambient O2 against pressure) and report which reference atmospheres (ISS cabin, Moon habitat, exploration, spacesuit) have no data. Use for gap questions.

fuel.description: a normalised fuel name, matched as a whole word: pmma, heptane (also n-heptane blends); ethane does not return methane

config.description: substring: normal, inverse, coflow, droplet, opposed flow, concurrent flow

pressure_kpa.description: [min, max]; null leaves that end open

flow_cm_s.description: [min, max]; null leaves that end open

outcome.description: solid-fuel runs of BASS (PSI-26) and BASS-II (PSI-25) only: how the flame ended, read from the crew's notes; each row quotes its source in outcome_quote and gives outcome_cause (blowoff, low_flow, nitrogen, unspecified) when extinguished. Null on most rows: not stated

exclude_flags.description: drop rows carrying any of these flag codes

name: relevance
description: Rank investigations by relevance to a fire-safety scenario and state how far the nearest real test is from it. fuel_phase weights the ranking and does not filter it: check `phase_match` on each row; `nearest_test` is always a test of that phase (null if none), and `closest_same_phase_test` is the nearest one overall. Never present `nearest_test_other_phase` as a test of the requested material. Scenario names: iss-cabin, moon-habitat, mars-habitat, pressurised-rover, spacecraft-transit.

scenario.description: scenario name, or {x_o2, pressure_kpa, flow_cm_s, gravity_g}

name: find_evidence
description: Keyword search for passages: reviewed digest findings (with citation ids) and raw text of PSI documents (file and page). Keyword-based: use the documents' own terms and try synonyms.

name: timeseries
description: Sensor time series of one test (decimated) with summary features (burn duration, peak temperatures, chamber pressure). Available for PSI-10, PSI-23, PSI-39, PSI-159 and Saffire-I/III (PSI-98, PSI-100). For 24 PSI-39 droplet tests the investigators' reduced data (droplet diameter, hot- and cool-flame diameter, radiometer power against time) are a second recording: test_point "FLEX-<test id>-reduced". Reads the raw NASA files: from disk in a local copy; the demo server fetches each from NASA PSI on first use and caches it, so a recording nobody opened before fails with 502 while PSI is down.

name: predict
description: Small per-investigation statistical model. Without model_id: list models, their inputs, accuracy and valid domain. With model_id plus every input of that model as extra named arguments: prediction (none outside the fitted domain) and the nearest real tests. The full list is about 75 kB: pass compact=true to get only id, inputs with their valid domain, accuracy and what each model must not be used for.

compact.description: with no model_id: the short list (about 5 kB)

name: discrepancies
description: Errors and doubts in the original PSI experiment tables: conflicts with the raw sensor data (table value, raw value, evidence, action taken), every value this dataset changed, flag meanings and counts, and statements resting on files PSI lists as removed. Use whenever the user asks about data quality or when showing a test whose row has flags.
